messages:
tara: quick ask — I need org-level Reader on `telemetry-prod` to pull LLM traces + associated BigQuery rows to debug a customer reproducible error. 2 hours tops. is org Reader the least-privileged way?

james: short answer: probably not org-level. can you list exactly which resources you need? logs? bq datasets? stackdriver views? :thinking_face:

tara: primarily: 1) logs in projects/telemetry-prod (Stackdriver) 2) BigQuery dataset telemetry_llm_traces for the trace rows 3) access to the trace viewing UI for correlation. not editing, just read.

irina: +1 to james. we should avoid org-level. options: a) project-level Reader on telemetry-prod + bq.dataViewer on the specific dataset OR b) create a custom role that grants `logging.views.get` + `bigquery.tables.getData` limited to dataset — then grant ephemeral access via our JIT system.

sec-bot: INCIDENT-ACCESS: Please open an ephemeral access request if this is for production customer debug. Link: https://auth.redwood.internal/jit-request

tara: thanks. prefer ephemeral flow. quick Q: what permissions exactly to ask for in the JIT form so approvers see the minimal scope?

james: in the form put: "Project: telemetry-prod — Roles: roles/viewer (project-level) is broad; instead request roles/logging.viewer on project + roles/bigquery.dataViewer on dataset `telemetry_prod.llm_traces`". add duration 2h and justify "customer reproducer for P0".

irina: if you can, add resource-level constraints in the justification: dataset ID + log bucket name. also flag that you won't export raw PII and will follow redaction guidelines.

sam: if ops approves, I'll pre-create a custom role template you can paste into the JIT form to make it explicit. gist snippet:```json
{
  "title": "Telemetry LLM Trace Reader (temp)",
  "permissions": ["logging.logEntries.list","logging.logEntries.get","bigquery.tables.get","bigquery.tables.list","bigquery.jobs.create"]
}
```

james: small nit: `bigquery.jobs.create` might be unnecessary if you only run SELECTs via the console. but some UIs create jobs under the hood. leave but document it.

tara: perfect. I opened the JIT request (ID JIT-7642) and linked the dataset + logs. tagged @james @irina for review.

sec-bot: JIT-7642 status: PENDING APPROVAL from sec-team. Approvers: @irina, @james.

irina: approving now. will limit duration to 90 minutes instead of 2h (less blast radius). please run in incognito and avoid copying raw user text to external tools.

james: approved from my side. sam — cancel the pre-create if we don't need separate role?

sam: leaving role draft in my notes; won't attach to the grant. tara — once you're done, drop a short post with what you accessed (dataset, log names) so security can close JIT ticket cleanly.

tara: will do. thanks all :bow:
